caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a man dressed in 18th-century attire, standing upright on a square base. The man has a neutral facial expression and wears a black tricorne hat, a long black coat, a beige or light brown vest with visible buttons, a white cravat, dark knee-length breeches, and knee-high stockings. He holds a wooden walking stick in his right hand and his left hand is slightly clenched at his side, with a small book or pouch hanging by his left hip. The statue is predominantly shaded in blacks, browns, and grays with some flesh tones for the face and hands, and subtle hints of blue and green on the clothing, suggesting shadow or reflected light. The square base is dark with a yellowish plaque on the front containing barely legible handwritten text. The entire figure is centered within a simple pencil-drawn rectangular border on a plain beige background.
title: Figure of Knickerbocker
